mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST declined by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over two months signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 2% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment conducive to equity investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 over two months signals a weakening labor market, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000 over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a significant weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines & UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS declined and UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a significant increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over three months signals a tightening monetary policy coupled with a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases & GDPC1 declines > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased and GDPC1 declined by more than 1% over three months.
